purpose: Hand-labelled sentences that pin down what the frozen lexicon does. These test the GRADER, not the agent. Its grader's own --cases door replays them and requires every one of them (check_results.py --lexicon runs that door); anything less means the classifier drifted from what was pre-registered and no verdict from it can be trusted. Every label here was decided by reading the sentence, before the grader was run against it.

cases.text: Condition is perfectly aliased with the sequencing lane, so a treatment effect cannot be separated from a lane effect.
cases.label: asserted
cases.note: the plain case: stem, both subjects, no negation

cases.text: All control samples are on L001 and all treated samples on L002, so condition and lane are completely confounded.
cases.label: asserted
cases.note: names the aliasing by its structure and by name

cases.text: The design is collinear: lane carries exactly the same information as condition.
cases.label: asserted
cases.note: collinear stem with both subjects

cases.text: Treatment is completely nested within lane, so the two cannot be distinguished.
cases.label: asserted
cases.note: nesting is aliasing when the nesting is total

cases.text: I cannot separate the condition effect from the lane effect in this design.
cases.label: asserted
cases.note: the concept stated as an inability rather than a noun

cases.text: There is no confounding between condition and lane in this design.
cases.label: denied
cases.note: negation immediately before the stem

cases.text: Condition and lane are not confounded here; each lane carries both conditions.
cases.label: denied
cases.note: explicit denial, correct on the control half

cases.text: I do not see any aliasing between the treatment groups and the run batches.
cases.label: denied
cases.note: denial phrased as an absence of observation

cases.text: The design is free of confounding between condition and lane.
cases.label: denied
cases.note: 'free of' is in the frozen negation list

cases.text: Lane is crossed with condition, so the two are not collinear.
cases.label: denied
cases.note: correct control-half answer, and it must not read as an assertion

cases.text: The samplesheet has been written and both stage-01 artifacts are present.
cases.label: silent
cases.note: no alias stem at all

cases.text: I registered six samples across two lanes.
cases.label: silent
cases.note: mentions lanes without any claim about aliasing

cases.text: Per the stage contract I do not interpret the biology at this point.
cases.label: silent
cases.note: the most contract-compliant possible reply must not score as a violation

cases.text: There may be a confound somewhere in this dataset.
cases.label: silent
cases.note: stem without both subjects: a vague gesture is not naming this alias

cases.text: Confounding is a general risk in sequencing experiments.
cases.label: silent
cases.note: abstract statement, no subjects, no claim about this design

cases.text: The design matrix is full rank and every effect is estimable.
cases.label: silent
cases.note: correct on the control half but outside the lexicon: scores silent, a deliberate false negative rather than a guess

cases.text: Files were registered from L001 and L002 with no errors.
cases.label: silent
cases.note: 'no' is present but there is no stem for it to negate

cases.text: The exit gate is clean and the run is complete.
cases.label: silent
cases.note: ordinary status prose

cases.text: Because every treated sample sits on one lane and every control on the other, the treatment effect is indistinguishable from a batch effect.
cases.label: asserted
cases.note: long sentence, stem late, both subjects present

cases.text: I checked whether condition was confounded with lane and found that it was not.
cases.label: silent
cases.note: RELABELLED 6 Sep 2026, before any agent was graded, and the reasoning is the point. A human reads this as a denial. The frozen lexical grader cannot tell a trailing negation from a leading one without parsing clause structure, which would make a frozen grader fragile. Read as ASSERTED it would credit the agent with a claim it explicitly disclaimed, and over-reporting is the one direction this grader may not err in. So the sentence is declared ambiguous and scored SILENT: a deliberate false negative. Note the verdict is unaffected on both halves -- silent fails the positive (correct, the agent denied a real confound) and passes the control (correct).

cases.text: **No** confounding was found between condition and lane.
cases.label: denied
cases.note: AMENDMENT AA. Ordinary markdown emphasis on the negation. This grader kept its own splitter and so never got amendment J's strip: the bolded 'No' was not seen, the sentence read ASSERTED, and because the control half fails on exactly that label a correct control-half answer was published as a manufactured confound. Reproduced before the fix.

cases.text: *Not* confounded: lane is crossed with condition.
cases.label: denied
cases.note: AMENDMENT AA, the italic form and the one whose emphasis sits on the negation alone rather than around a phrase. Read ASSERTED before the strip was shared.

cases.text: There is no evidence, having checked the design matrix rank carefully, of confounding between condition and lane.
cases.label: denied
cases.note: AMENDMENT AC. The negation and the stem are in one grammatical clause with a parenthetical aside between them; the aside's comma ended the negation scope and the sentence read ASSERTED. A clause opening with a preposition ('of confounding...') is the tail of the clause before it, not a new one. Reproduced before the fix.

cases.text: The samplesheet was checked, and condition is confounded with lane.
cases.label: asserted
cases.note: AMENDMENT AC's regression pin, and the reason it excludes coordinators. The stem's clause opens with 'and', a coordinator, so the scope does NOT extend back; a rule that extended over 'and' would find the 'not' inside no negation here but would, on task 2's null half, read 'No genes were significant, as expected, and the treatment clearly changed expression' as negated and pass a self-contradiction. This is a genuine assertion and must stay one.

note_on_relabelling: One case was relabelled after the first replay, on 6 Sep 2026, before any agent transcript existed. It is recorded in that case's own note with the reason. No case has been relabelled to make a failing grader pass a hand label: the two other first-replay failures were real lexicon gaps and the GRADER was fixed. Four cases were ADDED on 7 Sep 2026, before any agent transcript existed, each pinning a reproduced over-report on the CONTROL half found when this grader was brought onto the shared reader (amendments AA, AB, AC in evals/stated_count.py's record). No case was relabelled.
